meta.siteDescription: Solve algorithm and math problems with instant automated judging. Python, C++ and Go are supported.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.metaDescription: Sign in through the Telegram bot in seconds — no password needed.
auth.lead: No password. The Telegram bot gives you a one-time code.
auth.step2: The bot replies with a 6-digit code
auth.invalidCode: The code is wrong or has expired. Get a new one from the bot.
auth.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.
auth.offline: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.genericError: Could not sign in. Please try again.
auth.expiryNote: The code is valid for 2 minutes.

home.mascotAlt: The binary mascot — a gopher in a hard hat holding a tablet
home.title: Start from 0. One step forward.
home.subtitle: Learn programming fundamentals and algorithms through hands-on problems. Your solution is judged automatically — learn from mistakes and move to the next level.
home.step1Text: By subject, topic and difficulty — whatever fits you.
home.step2Text: In Python, C++ or Go — right here, and try it on your own input first.
home.step3Text: Every test is checked separately, so you see exactly where it stopped.
home.roadmapText: Contests, rating and courses — they arrive as the problem set grows.
home.taglineText: Every big skill starts with one small step. Solve problems, learn from your mistakes, and be one step further every day.
